scope.post_DP_clause_universe: nonduplicate non-tautological binary clauses over variables already present in each post-DP state
scope.source_lift: lift a selected post-DP binary cover clause to the source as the identical non-pivot clause, in addition to that state's already-sealed R50G24 pair witness

phase_A_exact_minimum.task: Find the exact minimum cardinality of the static necessary-incidence cover for each of the 991 unique >=3 states, not merely a lower bound of three.
requirements: every currently blocked-clause direct-additive support debt is hit
every currently accepted BVE pivot-touch debt is hit
phase_A_exact_minimum.minimum_is_relative_to: this finite binary-incidence universe and these already-existing necessary debts only

phase_B_source_realizability.task: For one exact-minimum cover witness per unique state, rebuild an original frozen skeleton witness plus its two sealed R50G24 clauses, add the minimum-cover clauses at source level, replay exact DP on pivot 1, and compare the transformed formula to canonical(post_DP_state + cover).
phase_B_source_realizability.exact_realization_condition: DP(source + sealed_pair + lifted_cover, pivot=1) == canonical(target_post_DP_state + cover)
phase_B_source_realizability.record_but_do_not_promote: the first R33 rule and terminal behavior after the source-realized minimum cover

forbidden_claims: minimum incidence cover is sufficient to disable BCE and BVE
minimum incidence cover prevents new simplification doors
a source-realized cover yields a hard SAT core
the computed minimum is universal outside the sealed states
